description: This Java class implements a WebSocket server handler for the MockServer project, managing WebSocket upgrade requests, message handling, and connection lifecycle events.

classes.name: EchoWebSocketServerHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler for managing WebSocket connections, including upgrade, message handling, and connection cleanup.

methods.name: channelRead
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, performing WebSocket upgrade or message processing.

methods.name: channelReadComplete
methods.description: Flushes the channel after read completion.

methods.name: upgradeChannel
methods.description: Performs WebSocket handshake and registers the client.

methods.name: handleWebSocketFrame
methods.description: Processes WebSocket frames such as close, text, and ping frames.

methods.name: exceptionCaught
methods.description: Logs exceptions and closes the channel.
